twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.subTitle: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring an authentication code at sign-in.

setup.title: Set up authenticator app
setup.description: A virtual MFA device is an application running on your device that you can configure by scanning a QR code.
setup.step1: Install a compatible authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Duo Mobile, or Authy, on your phone or computer.
setup.step2: Open your authenticator app and scan this QR code. You can also enter the secret key manually.
setup.qrCodeAlt: QR code for authenticator app setup
setup.step3: Enter the 6-digit code generated by your app.
setup.loadFailed: Failed to start 2FA setup. Please try again.
setup.invalidCode: Invalid verification code. Please try again.

backupCodes.title: Save your backup codes
backupCodes.description: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app.

disableDialog.title: Disable two-factor authentication
disableDialog.description: Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.

check.title: Secure your account
check.subTitle: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of protection to your account by requiring a code from your phone in addition to your password.
